name: aidlc-vibe
description: Free-form coding that still sediments. No workflow rails, no gate until you close out; memory and knowledge load as usual and learnings go back through the framework's admission gate. Makes no correctness claim about what you build.
welcomeMessage: Free-form session. I open a container on the first turn so learnings have a way home, then get out of the way. Say "sediment" to harvest what you learned, "close" to end the session.
